provenance.description: simulation command envelope; not measured motor dynamics

provenance.validation: requested and applied body commands, wheel targets, limiting flags, and stop phase are recorded per physics step

provenance.method: enabled drive-wheel collider union in Carter root coordinates

localization_planning_margin_provenance.application: added to the qualified evaluation radius only for Nav2 robot_radius
localization_planning_margin_provenance.evaluation_contract: the 0.2 m footprint clearance remains unchanged

control_limit_provenance.kind: authored qualification limits; not motor calibration
control_limit_provenance.purpose: bound the G2 two-robot qualification command envelope

nav2_rotation_command_provenance.kind: authored controller request-profile calibration; not motor calibration
nav2_rotation_command_provenance.basis: 10 Hz RPP first heading request is 0.2 rad/s; prior actual asset test showed little yaw response at 0.08 rad/s, without identifying a single mechanical cause
nav2_rotation_command_provenance.unchanged_limits: RPP target 0.5 rad/s, bridge acceleration 0.5 rad/s2 and yaw goal tolerance

nav2_goal_tolerance_provenance.kind: authored estimated-pose acceptance tolerance; not a measured docking accuracy
nav2_goal_tolerance_provenance.basis: F1-001 Nav2 success failed independent goal evaluation; reserve more position-error budget for localization
nav2_goal_tolerance_provenance.evaluation_contract: independent physics goal limits remain 0.35 m and 0.35 rad; simulator truth never feeds goal acceptance

scope.simulator_truth: evaluation and media only; never localization, routing, reservations or steering
scope.scan_filter: static sensor-frame forward half-plane; no truth-based self/peer filtering

localization_scan_fan_in.message_contract: filtered LaserScan frame_id, timestamp, angles, ranges and intensities are preserved; AMCL resolves each sensor extrinsic through TF

scope.authorization: short-lived dispatcher permission for the accepted goal and reservation; Twist has no goal UUID
scope.fault: F2 isolates traffic observation/authorization only, not the full DDS graph
scope.fleet_scale: 16 declared robot identities with inherited front/rear sensor definitions; configuration only, no USD spawn, sensor or physical runtime claim
